plan.summary:
Uploads now retry up to five times instead of three.

- `config/upload.yaml`: `retry.max_attempts` changes from 3 to 5.
- `backoff_ms` stays at 200 in the shown context.
plan.riskRationale: One config value changes. It raises the retry count and can add load or delay on repeated failures. No code or schema changes.
plan.storyArc: One config change raises the upload retry limit from three to five attempts. No other parts need to be connected.

topics.title: Raise upload retry limit to five attempts
topics.narrativeBrief: What retry behavior changes when `max_attempts` goes from 3 to 5? Verify in the full file whether `max_attempts` counts the first try or only retries, and note that `backoff_ms` is unchanged.
